definitions.short: the external abdomen , belly (as the source of the faetus)
definitions.full: H1512. gachon גָּחוֺן noun masculine belly , of reptiles (compare perhaps Assyrian gi—innu , cord (from twisting ?) Zim BP 104 ) — גְּחֹנְךָ Gen 3:14 (J) of the serpent, compare גָּחוֺן Lev 11:42 (P). גחר (? compare Arabic retire, retreat , etc.)
